TrackList.BrokenHint: This record is broken and can't be played until it is repaired.

GM.DeleteConfirmBody: Remove "{name}" from the shared track registry? Players who already collected it keep it in their history, but it will no longer appear in the Jukebox.

Manager.Empty: No records registered yet. Use "Add Track" to create one.
Manager.ResetAllConfirmBody: Mark every record as uncollected for the whole party? The records themselves are kept — only the party's collection progress is cleared.
Manager.MarkCollected: Mark as collected for the party
Manager.MarkUncollected: Mark as uncollected for the party
Manager.CollectingEnableHint: Allow the party to collect records again
Manager.CollectingDisableHint: Stop the party from collecting records
Manager.CollectingOnHint: Players can pick up records from scene and region music, pickups and items.
Manager.CollectingOffHint: Players cannot collect any records; only you can grant them here.
Manager.MarkBroken: Mark as broken: players keep it but can't play it
Manager.MarkRepaired: Repair: players can play it again

Rewards.Title: Reward track
Rewards.Hint: Milestones on the number line beside the Hideout Jukebox. Only intact collected records count.

SourceConfig.HearingRangeHint: Players hear the record player at full volume while one of their tokens is within this range, regardless of walls. 0 = the whole scene.

Settings.CollectionEnabledHint: When off, players cannot collect any records from scene or region music, map pickups or items. The GM can still grant records from the Music Tracks window.
Settings.RewardSoundHint: A short sound effect played for everyone whenever the party collects a new Jukebox track.

Settings.FadeHint: How long ambient music fades in when a token walks into a sound's radius, and fades out when it walks out. 0 switches instantly (Foundry's own behavior).

Timetable.RequiresCalendar: The Timetable requires the Simple Calendar Reborn module to be active.
Timetable.NotSetUp: The DM hasn't set up the timetable yet.
Timetable.HasNoteHint: This course has a note — click for details
Timetable.ConflictTooltip: {count} attendee(s) are also enrolled in another course at this time
Timetable.ConflictWarning: {actor} is also enrolled in another course at this time slot: {other}
Timetable.SetTermStartBody: Set the term's start date to the current in-game date? This resets which week counts as "This Week" and "Next Week".
Timetable.DropHint: Drag an actor from the sidebar onto this window, or pick one below, to enrol them.
Timetable.NameRequired: The course needs a name before it can be saved.
Timetable.DropAmbiguous: This slot has more than one course — drop the actor directly onto the course you want.

Characters.MenuHint: Which player characters show up in the Timetable's character lists. Untick utility or test characters.
Characters.Title: Timetable Characters
Characters.Hint: Ticked characters appear in the Timetable (Plan for, invitations, course attendees). New characters are ticked automatically.

Afternoon.NoCharacter: You don't own a player character to plan afternoons for.
Afternoon.Title: Title
Afternoon.ParticipantRequired: A DM appointment needs at least one character taking part.
Afternoon.ClashHint: Several appointments at the same time
Afternoon.ConflictWarning: {actor} already has something planned at this time: {titles}
Afternoon.TitleRequired: The appointment needs a title before it can be saved.
Afternoon.DeleteBody: Delete "{title}"? It also disappears from the invited characters' timetables.
Afternoon.NeedsGM: Appointments can only be saved while a DM is online.

Scene.TrackHint: Everyone viewing this scene hears this track, with or without a token on it. A "Replace Music" region overrides it.
Scene.NightTrackHint: Plays instead of the main music while the scene is dark, e.g. after "Transition to Darkness". Leave empty to keep the main music at night.

track.label: Jukebox Track
track.hint: Plays instead of the scene's main music (and the record player) while one of a player's tokens is inside this region.

nightTrack.label: Night Track
nightTrack.hint: Plays instead of the track above while the scene is dark, e.g. after "Transition to Darkness". Leave empty to keep the same track at night; with only a night track the region replaces music only at night.

Settings.RerollOnActivateName: Random NPCs: Reshuffle on Scene Activation
Settings.RerollOnActivateHint: When a scene is activated, remove the NPCs its Random NPCs regions placed and roll them anew. Turn off to keep the current NPCs; you can still reroll manually from the region buttons.

folder.label: Actor Folder
folder.hint: Random actors from this folder are placed in the region each time the scene is activated.

includeSubfolders.label: Include Subfolders
includeSubfolders.hint: Also use actors from folders inside the chosen folder.

baseChance.label: Chance per Space (%)
baseChance.hint: The chance that a free grid space inside the region receives an NPC.

neighborChance.label: Chance next to an NPC (%)
neighborChance.hint: The chance instead, if an adjacent space already has an NPC. Higher values form groups.

maxNpcs.label: Maximum NPCs
maxNpcs.hint: At most this many NPCs are placed. 0 = no limit.

uniqueActors.label: Each NPC Only Once
uniqueActors.hint: Place every actor from the folder at most once in this region. Then the folder size also limits how many NPCs can appear.

hidden.label: Place Hidden
hidden.hint: Place the NPCs hidden from players.

Warn.NoActors: Random NPCs (region "{region}"): the chosen folder contains no actors.
Warn.Gridless: Random NPCs (region "{region}"): gridless scenes are not supported.
Warn.NoSpace: Random NPCs (region "{region}"): no free space left.
Warn.AllUsed: Random NPCs (region "{region}"): every actor from the folder is already placed.

EladrinWildMagic.VolunteerText: You spent spell points on {spell}. Roll for a Wild Magic Surge? (d20 against Containment {c}; the ring keeps Containment from dropping.)
EladrinWildMagic.Tooltip: Containment: a surge happens when the d20 is equal to or higher than this number.
EladrinWildMagic.TooltipGM: Containment: a surge happens when the d20 is equal to or higher than this number. Click to edit.
EladrinWildMagic.FeyProposal: House-rule proposal, not yet agreed with the player.
EladrinWildMagic.FeyWinter: One creature within 5 ft makes a WIS save (DC {dc}) or has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of her next turn.
EladrinWildMagic.FeyOther: Current season: {season}. Only the Winter rider is defined so far; use the standard Eladrin effect for this season.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnDrainedLocked: The ring is drained until the next short rest. Only the GM can change it.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnNoVisage: Eladrin Wild Magic: the Visage module is not active, so her appearance was not changed.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnNoToken: Eladrin Wild Magic: {actor} has no token on the current scene, so her appearance was not changed.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnNoFace: Eladrin Wild Magic: {actor} has no Visage face named "{label}". Her appearance was not changed.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnVisageFailed: Eladrin Wild Magic: switching the Visage face failed. See the console.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnNoTable: Eladrin Wild Magic: roll table "{name}" was not found.
EladrinWildMagic.WarnNoSurgeToReroll: There is no surge to reroll.

chaPenalty.name: Ring: Charisma penalty (OPEN DECISION)
chaPenalty.hint: Default 0 = not implemented. Reduces the Charisma score while the ring is on or drained (2 gives DC 12 / +4 at CHA 17; the design document assumes CHA 18 with 2).

tickMode.name: Containment ticks per (OPEN DECISION)
tickMode.hint: Default: per spell (recommended, penalises Quickened double casts). Not yet confirmed.

floor.name: Containment floor (OPEN DECISION)
floor.hint: Default 11 (50%). Containment never sinks below this by casting. Not yet confirmed.

ringCost.name: Putting the ring on costs (OPEN DECISION)
ringCost.hint: Default: Action. Shown in the chat message only; the action is not spent automatically. Not yet confirmed.

spellPointsItem.name: Spell Points item name
spellPointsItem.hint: Fallback name of the Spell Points feature used to detect spell point spending.

face_winter.name: Visage face: Winter
face_winter.hint: Label of the Visage face used for Winter.

face_spring.name: Visage face: Spring
face_spring.hint: Label of the Visage face used for Spring.

face_summer.name: Visage face: Summer
face_summer.hint: Label of the Visage face used for Summer.

face_autumn.name: Visage face: Autumn
face_autumn.hint: Label of the Visage face used for Autumn.

face_default.name: Visage face: Default form
face_default.hint: Label of the Visage face for her default form, shown whenever the ring is on or drained. Leave blank to use the token's own base appearance (recommended).

SubclassDrop.NoClass: No {class} class was found in the dnd5e compendiums. Add the class to the actor first, then drop the subclass.

Botany.NoMembers: The Botany Club has no members yet. Add them in the module settings.
Botany.NotMember: None of your characters is in the Botany Club.
Botany.PlantTitle: What do you want to plant?
Botany.NoSeeds: You have no seeds in your inventory.
Botany.AdvanceHint: Lets every plant grow for one day

Botany.ConfirmDead: {plant} has withered. You can remove it, but you get nothing.

Members.Title: Manage the Botany Club
Members.MenuHint: Pick the characters in the Botany Club and the size of their garden.
Members.Hint: The players of these characters get "My Garden" in the Fimblewood controls. If you shrink a garden, the plants in the hidden beds stay saved.

AutoGrow.name: Botany Club: plants grow automatically
AutoGrow.hint: Every day change in Simple Calendar Reborn matures the plants. When off, they only grow when you set maturity or advance days yourself.

Notice.NotMember: That character is not in the Botany Club.
Notice.NoSeed: That seed is no longer in your inventory.
Notice.NoPlant: This seed does not grow into a plant. Ask the GM.
Notice.NoCharacter: You do not own a character.
Notice.PackMissing: The harvested item was not found in the compendium.
Notice.NothingGained: {plant} was not ripe yet. You get nothing.
Notice.NeedsGM: No GM is online to carry that out.
Notice.NotUsable: That cannot be used in the garden.
Notice.NeedsPlant: Nothing grows on this bed for the potion to destroy.
Notice.Fertilized: Growth on this bed is now ×{factor}.
Notice.ModInvalid: The factor must be between 0.1 and 10.

Growth.Title: Plant growth times
Growth.MenuHint: Set how many days each plant needs to ripen. Default: 5 / 8 / 12 / 30 days by rarity.
Growth.Hint: Days until ripe (100 %). The default depends on rarity: common 5, uncommon 8, rare 12, very rare 30. Plants already in the ground use the new time for their further growth right away.

Botany.NoPotions: You have no potions in your inventory.
Botany.NoFertilizers: You have no fertilizer in your inventory.
Botany.PotionTitle: Which potion do you want to use?
Botany.FertilizerTitle: Which fertilizer do you want to use?
Botany.ModHint: They belong to a bed until the next plant on it is harvested. Your growth factor adds to the bed's potion and fertilizer. Leave blank = unchanged, 1 = remove the factor.
Botany.ModClear: Remove all modifiers of the bed

Prices.Title: Potion prices
Prices.MenuHint: Set the price of every potion and tier, with all tiers side by side.
Prices.Hint: Prices in gold pieces. Default: tier I {a}, tier II {b}, tier III {c}. The compendium keeps the default prices. Your price applies once a potion comes from the compendium into the world or onto a character.
Prices.ApplyExisting: Also apply to potions that already exist (in the world and in inventories)

Alchemy.NoCharacter: You do not own a character.
Alchemy.NoTools: You have no tools right now. Find them in your inventory or in an alchemy room.

ToolInfo.reisekessel: A portable cauldron: brews one potion at a time.
ToolInfo.kelle: With the ladle you add water, oil and moon dew by the cup. Without it no liquid goes into the cauldron.
ToolInfo.moerser: Grinds raw ingredients. Herbs, flowers and crystals go in ground, mushrooms and fruit raw.
ToolInfo.braukessel: A large cauldron with several slots: each slot brews its own potion, all at once.
ToolInfo.destille: With the alembic close by, tier II potions succeed. You brew at the cauldron.
ToolInfo.athanor: The alchemical furnace makes tier III potions possible and allows moon dew in the cauldron. You brew at the cauldron.
ToolInfo.oelbad: The oil bath heats oil: no oil in the cauldron without it. You brew at the cauldron.

Alchemy.NothingToGrind: No raw ingredients in the inventory.

Hint.unknown: The ingredients do not go together.
